_provenance.purpose: the project's own honesty record of which external figures are contaminated
_provenance.lock_state: written at the lock; see post_lock_addendum for what changed after it

note: 0.821 is the only uncontaminated external figure: a Pitt-trained model evaluated on Lu once, before any modelling decision was informed by it. The later 0.859 and 0.849 must NOT be reported as external validation -- 0.859 was obtained after using Lu to judge whether to add Delaware, and 0.849 is cross-validated performance within a model that includes Lu in training.
post_lock_addendum: Added 2026-08-22. The sentence above ('the only uncontaminated external figure') was written BEFORE the 18 August lock and is true only of the pre-lock period. Since the lock there is a second clean figure: the one-shot 0.853 [0.737, 0.946] in locked_external_validation.json, produced by a model that never saw Lu in training, at a threshold fixed in advance, scored once and reproduced once. Both are reported in the thesis: 0.821 validates external generalisation of a Pitt-only model with no Lu influence anywhere; 0.853 validates the deployed system on unseen data, with the caveat that its training pool's COMPOSITION was chosen using a Lu result. See docs/LU_EXPOSURE_TIMELINE.md and docs/THESIS_PLAN.md 3.9.
